description: This file defines the WorkerInfo class and related resource management classes for Spark's deploy master component, including resource acquisition, release, and worker state management.

classes.name: WorkerResourceInfo
classes.description: Represents resource information for a worker, including resource name and addresses, and provides resource acquisition functionality.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Manages information about a Spark worker node, including resources, executors, drivers, state, and heartbeat management.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Acquires a specified number of addresses as resources for the worker.

methods.name: addExecutor
methods.description: Adds an executor to the worker, updating resource usage.

methods.name: removeExecutor
methods.description: Removes an executor from the worker, releasing resources.

methods.name: hasExecutor
methods.description: Checks if the worker has an executor associated with a given application.

methods.name: addDriver
methods.description: Adds a driver to the worker, updating resource usage.

methods.name: removeDriver
methods.description: Removes a driver from the worker, releasing resources.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the worker.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the worker is in ALIVE state.

methods.name: acquireResources
methods.description: Acquires specified resources for drivers or executors.

methods.name: releaseResources
methods.description: Releases resources allocated to drivers or executors.
